proposals.before: After Emperor Yinyou came to the throne, Guo Wei of Later Zhou held the post of Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner. Liu Chong told his registrar Zheng Xiong, "Guo and I have never gotten along. The throne is held by a boy. Once Guo has his way, my whole line is finished."
proposals.after: After Emperor Yinyou came to the throne, Guo Wei of Later Zhou held the post of Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner. Liu Chong told his registrar Zheng Gong, "Guo and I have never gotten along. The throne is held by a boy. Once Guo has his way, my whole line is finished."
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄭珙 is Zheng Gong (珙 gǒng), not Xiong; the English personal name is wrong.

proposals.before: When Emperor Yinyou succeeded to the throne, the Later Zhou founder served as commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Chong said to his registrar Zheng Xiong: "I have never been on good terms with Commissioner Guo. The court is ruled by a child. If Guo gets his way, there will be none of my kind left."
proposals.after: When Emperor Yinyou succeeded to the throne, the Later Zhou founder served as commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Chong said to his registrar Zheng Gong: "I have never been on good terms with Commissioner Guo. The court is ruled by a child. If Guo gets his way, there will be none of my kind left."
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄭珙 is Zheng Gong, not Xiong.

proposals.before: Xiong then urged him to put arms and armor in order, recruit outlaws and fugitives, and plan how to save himself.
proposals.after: Gong then urged him to put arms and armor in order, recruit outlaws and fugitives, and plan how to save himself.
proposals.reason: Short form 珙 continues Zheng Gong; English wrongly uses Xiong from the prior mistranslation.

proposals.before: Xiong thereupon urged him to repair weapons and armor, gather fugitives, and make plans to preserve himself.
proposals.after: Gong thereupon urged him to repair weapons and armor, gather fugitives, and make plans to preserve himself.
proposals.reason: Short form 珙 is Gong, not Xiong.

proposals.before: He made his son Liu Jun Taiyuan governor, appointed his registrars Zhao Hua and Zheng Xiong as chancellors, and made Chen Guangyu Palace Secretariat commissioner.

proposals.before: He changed the era name to Tianhui, made Wei Rong chancellor, Duan Chang Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, Wei Jin commander of the personal army, and his son Ji'en Taiyuan governor.
proposals.after: He changed the era name to Tianhui, made Wei Rong chancellor, Duan Chang commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Wei Jin commander of the personal army, and his son Ji'en governor of Taiyuan.

proposals.before: In the second month of Qiande 2, Li Jixun, horse-and-army controller Kang Yanhao, and combined-forces commander Yin Xun attacked Liaozhou. Jun sent Hao Guichao to relieve the city; the battle below the walls ended in a rout.
proposals.after: In the second month of Qiande 2, Li Jixun, horse-and-army controller Kang Yanzhao, and combined-forces commander Yin Xun attacked Liaozhou. Jun sent Hao Guichao to relieve the city; the battle below the walls ended in a rout.
proposals.reason: Chinese 康延沼 is Kang Yanzhao (沼 zhǎo), not Yanhao.

proposals.before: In the second month of the second year of Qiande, Li Jixun with the horse-and-army controller Kang Yanhao and the combined-forces commander Yin Xun led troops to attack Liaozhou. Jun sent Hao Guichao to relieve it; they fought below the walls and were utterly defeated.

proposals.before: Four more of Jun's men, including Yaozhou militia commissioner Zhou Shenyu, defected. Shenyu received court robes, a gold belt, a thousand bolts of silk, five hundred taels of silver, and a saddled horse; he was renamed Chengjing and made a Left Palace Interior Service general while holding Fenzhou militia commissioner.
proposals.after: Four more of Jun's men, including Yaozhou militia commissioner Zhou Shenyu, defected. proposals.reason: Chinese 承晉 is Chengjin, not Chengjing.
